description: This Java source file defines the class AcknowledgementRequestDuplicateCorrelationIdException, a custom exception used within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.acks.base package. It represents an error case where an acknowledgement request has a duplicate correlation ID that was recently used, indicating a conflict in request processing.
